controls.capDescription: Verified source enforces supported collateral transfer, exact stable-value ratio at the current zero-delta setting, authorized MINTER_ROLE caller, and maxMintPerBlock. The current cap is 25,000,000 avUSD per Avalanche block.

controls.label: AvantMintingV2 MINTER_ROLE caller
controls.capDescription: This EOA can call the immutable gateway, but each call remains bounded by collateral transfer, signature and route validation, and the 25,000,000 avUSD per-block gateway cap.

At Avalanche block 96511144, hasRole(keccak256(MINTER_ROLE), this address) remains true and eth_getCode is empty. Verified source restricts cap changes to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Current caller uniqueness was not re-established because the RPC plan limits event queries to 500 blocks.

controls.label: Avant avUSD token owner and gateway admin
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 96511144, avUSD.owner() returned this EOA and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) on AvantMintingV2 returned true; eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. The token owner can set minters, while the gateway admin can grant caller roles and raise maxMintPerBlock. Avant's current secure-asset-management disclosure describes multi-provider MPC custody and transaction policies without naming vendors or publishing an address-specific custody attestation.

review.evidence: Complete Avalanche role and MinterUpdated event replays through block 90283689, followed by direct hasRole() and minters(address) checks, establish one gateway caller and one active token minter. maxMintPerBlock() returned 25,000,000 avUSD, stablesDeltaLimit() returned zero, and the common admin/owner EOA can raise the cap or replace minters. Verified constructors and zero EIP-1967 slots establish immutable token and gateway code. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the issuer EOA can raise the cap or replace minters without an independent timelock, while no whole-supply recurring reconciliation or prudential supervisor is evidenced. Wave 2 external review 2026-08-15: Avant's live API reports dated strategy NAV, assets, and financing liabilities, but it does not reconcile aggregate avUSD token liabilities across Avalanche and every CCIP spoke, so reconciliation remains unknown. Reconciliation determination 2026-08-15: retained unknown with a named gap. The Avant transparency API reports NAV and asset/liability totals only on dated snapshots (2026-08-04 at the R02 refresh), and neither it nor the curated-validated adapter establishes liability coverage across the Avalanche mint hub plus the Monad CCIP spoke; the issuer EOA can replace token minters immediately, so supply expansion between dated snapshots escapes the feed. A live whole-supply liability join would qualify this for continuous/periodic. Wave 1 reconciliation review 2026-08-15: the live Avant transparency API is dated and reports strategy assets, liabilities, and NAV, but it does not join total avUSD token liabilities on Avalanche and the Monad CCIP spoke to those reserves; no named recurring attestation was found, so reconciliation remains unknown and supervision remains none.
